biotools.summary: ROCpower is an R package and Shiny app designed to perform simulation-based power analyses for ROC curve and area under the curve (AUC) analyses. The resource provides a tutorial on how to conduct these analyses, highlighting the importance of the smallest effect size of interest (SESOI).
